verdict.rationale: n8n's own GitHub repo advertises 1500+ integrations, and its docs show a large built-in node and credential catalog spanning many SaaS vendors (Slack, HubSpot, Jira, GitHub, Notion, Okta, Datadog and more). A community user confirms the value of not having to build and maintain API integrations. One user reports thin docs for at least one node (Kafka trigger). missing for 10: explicit documentation that n8n itself maintains these built-in integrations, a catalog size clearly in the 'thousands' rather than 1500+, and consistent per-integration documentation depth.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can connect to thousands of apps through prebuilt, vendor-maintained integrations

citations.quote: 1500+ integrations and 9,000+ workflow templates to connect AI with your existing systems
All plans include unlimited users & workflows and every integration.
One reason is not having to build and maintain integrations with lots of APIs for workflows that are just run once in a while
N8n looks quite polished and seems primarily concerned about connecting pre-made blocks.
